column4: Privacy exists at /privacy - linked from SiteFooter and RiskDisclaimer. Frame was already built against 2311:5968 (LegalDocument shell). Verified numerically at 1440: 11 sections in Figma order, 912px column at x=293 of 1440 (equal 264px gutters), 26px section gaps, type exact (h1 Manrope 42/48 w300 ls-1.68px; sec-num Mulish 22/26; h2 Manrope 18/24; sub-head Manrope 14/18 bold; body+bullets 14/18; note 12/16; lede Mulish 16/16 #56C7F3). No TOC, no per-clause cards, no back-to-top pill; doc region carries 5 controls only (footer nav + logo) so zero SURPLUS chrome inside the frame region. FIXED this pass - sec 6 rendered a 2-col table where frame 2311:6437 draws a 7-item bullet list; sec 5 and 6 ledes were Manrope 14 body where frames 2311:6406 and 2311:6436 use the Mulish 16/16 label style in body colour - LegalLede gained a tone prop; table header radius was 12px via rounded-lg because this app maps --radius to 0.75rem, now the literal 8px the frame draws. NOT match because MISSING remains - frame ambient glow ellipse 2311:5969 and the engraved footer artwork 2311:5970 (~2400 vector nodes) need exported assets not hand-authored SVG. Also 3 code-only GDPR clauses post-date the mock (2.5 lawful bases, 5.4 supervisory authority, 7.3 no-third-party-tracking) plus a Duration column and analytics retention row - retained on purpose, dropping a GDPR clause to match a mock would be a compliance regression. Heading COPY discrepancies reported not changed - frame labels sec 4 and 11 with repeats of 3 and 5, and reuses Security and Fraud Prevention over 3.2 4.1 7.2 content; frame date is Feb 6 2025 vs live Jul 4 2026. Which wording is authoritative is a legal decision.
